tags.name: IA NCA 9
tags.source:name: Newberry Library Atlas of Historical County Boundaries
tags.start_event: Non-County Area 9 lost to creation of Non-County Area 11; Non-County Area 11 detached from POLK, attached to DALLAS ""for election, revenue, and judicial purposes.""

tags.name: IA NCA 9
tags.nl_ahcb:source: Iowa Acts 1846-1847, ch. 84, sec. 1/pp. 100-101; Swisher, ""Organization of Counties,"" 519-520
tags.source:name: Newberry Library Atlas of Historical County Boundaries
tags.start_event: Non-County Area 9 attached to POLK lost to creation of POTTAWATTAMIE.

tags.name: IA NCA 9
tags.source:name: Newberry Library Atlas of Historical County Boundaries
tags.start_event: Non-County Area 9 attached to POLK lost to unorganized federal territory when the state of Iowa was created from Iowa Territory; Non-County Area 9 eliminated from present Minnesota, North Dakota, and South Dakota.

tags.name: IA NCA 9
tags.source:name: Newberry Library Atlas of Historical County Boundaries
tags.start_event: Non-County Area 9 created from all of Non-County Area 8 and part of Non-County Areas 6 and 7; included parts of present Iowa, Minnesota, and North and South Dakota. Non-County Area 9 attached to POLK ""for election, revenue, and judicial purposes.""

tags.name: IA NCA 7
tags.source:name: Newberry Library Atlas of Historical County Boundaries
tags.start_event: Non-County Area 7 attached to LINN lost to creation of BOONE, MARSHALL, and STORY.

tags.name: IA NCA 7
tags.nl_ahcb:source: Iowa Terr. Rev. Stat. 1843, ch. 34; secs. 5-6, 8-11/pp. 132-134
tags.source:name: Newberry Library Atlas of Historical County Boundaries
tags.start_event: Non-County Area 7 created from BENTON; Non-County Area 7 attached to LINN ""for judicial, revenue, and election purposes.""

tags.name: Dubuque County
tags.nl_ahcb:source: Terr. Papers U.S., 27:41-52; U.S. Stat., vol. 5, ch. 54 [1836]/pp. 10-16
tags.source:name: Newberry Library Atlas of Historical County Boundaries
tags.start_event: DUBUQUE became a Wisconsin Territory county when Wisconsin Territory was created from Michigan Territory; DUBUQUE created by Michigan Territory on 1 Oct 1834.

tags.name: Dubuque County
tags.source:name: Newberry Library Atlas of Historical County Boundaries
tags.start_event: DUBUQUE created by Michigan Territory from non-county area in present Iowa, Minnesota, and North and South Dakota.
